name: Toriko no Tsubasa ~Butaiura de Midara ni Odoru Marionette~
original_name: 虜ノ翼 ～舞台裏で淫らに踊る処女人形～
source:
Neya Ikumi is a female student at Minomori Academy. She was abandoned shortly after birth and was placed in an orphanage. Every day, she studied quietly and diligently in order to obtain the means to live alone.

Therein, she made her first friend, and her school life became colorful. The first friend, Tougasaki Yuno, had been a stage actress since she was a child, and she was also a member of the academy's drama club. Influenced by her, Ikumi joined the drama club and, thanks to her, came to be on good terms with Shiraishiri Ririsa and Mukai Kasumi. Although a little awkward, school life with friends was nevertheless delightful.

Nevertheless, a shadow has slowly started to loom over these days... It began when Yuno and Kasumi's expressions darkened. Because the protagonist had no prior experience counseling friends, she was unsure of what to do and grew impatient. However, once she discovered that the source of their woes was a certain talent agency, she attempted to follow the thread in order to unravel the mystery. While searching for the information, Ikumi met with certain people, like porn actress Hatsuse Miki, and was getting closer to the truth.

[i]But what awaited her was the dense darkness of the show business world, full of obscenity!..[/i]

[Translated from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonotsubasa/]official site[/url]]
